scenario: Jordan wants a quick reminder set for picking up groceries later today.

turns.text: Hey can you remind me to pick up groceries at 5pm?
Sure, I'll remind you to pick up groceries at 5pm today.
Thanks!
You're welcome!

expected.agent_should: Set a reminder for 5pm and respond politely to the follow up.

scenario: A duplicate webhook is received while Morgan is confirming a meeting time.

turns.text: Are we still on for the meeting at 3pm?
Yes, we're still on for 3pm today.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM4e72f376b5584a3aa1d857586297f362
Yes, we're still on for 3pm today.
Perfect, see you then.
See you then!

must_not: send two different answers to the duplicate

scenario: Cameron attempts to opt out of messages after receiving a reminder.

turns.text: Just a heads up, your laundry will be done in 10 minutes.
Got it, I'll be over soon.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
START
carrier opt-in confirmation sent
Welcome back! Ready to help when you need me.

expected.agent_should: Respect the opt-out keyword by ceasing outbound messages after STOP, and resume service after START without sending automated responses to the carrier keywords themselves.

scenario: Riley needs help with the available commands for their assistant.

turns.text: HELP
You can ask me to set reminders, check tasks, or schedule quick events. Just say what you need!
Can you list my tasks for today?
You have 1 task today: water the plants at 7pm.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise help response when HELP is sent, then properly handle the follow up task request.

scenario: Alex is trying to get a summary while also sending a duplicate and requesting help all in quick succession.

turns.text: Can you summarize my notes from yesterday?

Yesterday: picked up supplies, called about an appointment, and paid a small bill.
HELP
Ask me for summaries, reminders, or quick follow ups. Just say your request!

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate of the summary request, avoid re-sending a new unique summary, and still respond to the HELP keyword with guidance.

turns.text: Can we move my walk from 6pm to 7pm?

turns.text: START
carrier opt-in confirmation processed

Okay, add laundry after the store.

message from non-allowlisted sender rejected
Seriously, answer me!
message from non-allowlisted sender rejected

scenario: Owner inquires about their upcoming week while utilizing emoji reactions.

Nice! Can you also squeeze in a quick walk for Thursday morning?
Done! Thu AM: walk added to your week ✨

scenario: Owner attempts to receive help after an unknown number previously tried to message the agent.

You have 1 active reminder: vitamins at 9 PM tonight.
